_note: Skeleton for docs/hygiene-protected.json — the factory's own declaration of which paths inside its scratch namespace are LIVE STATE, read by tools/hygiene.py before it unlinks anything and by the classifier leg of tests/test_hygiene_namespace.py. Copy it into docs/ (the example itself is never read) and leave BOTH lists empty unless your factory has one. WHY THIS IS A FILE AND NOT A FLAG: the reaper is its own auditor, and a runtime flag is a declaration a cron forgets, so the reaper would go on unlinking what the declaration meant to protect (#153). WHY NOT A CONSTANT IN THE TOOL: the tool is paired byte-identically with its template copy, so one factory's live paths must not ship to every new factory. THE DEFECT THIS PREVENTS: the reap is AGE-ONLY — MAX_AGE_HOURS, the age test and the unlink are the only discriminators — so a lock created once and held long-term has an mtime nothing refreshes and is indistinguishable from litter. Harm is UNWITNESSED on the evidence available, so this surface ships as PREVENTION, not repair. Each entry has two REQUIRED fields: `path` (an absolute /tmp path inside YOUR namespace) and `why` (why it is live, or why it is genuinely reapable); a blank `why` is REFUSED when the declaration is read, because an entry nobody could defend in the output is one that should be fixed instead. `protected` entries are SKIPPED by the reaper — never reported as stale, never unlinked — and every run prints how many are declared, so a reaper protecting nothing can never read as one protecting everything. `scratch` entries are ordinary litter that the classifier must still see classified, so the gate can tell a literal somebody considered from one nobody did. An entry matching NOTHING is printed but is NOT an error: the point of prevention is to declare a path BEFORE the code that creates it lands, which is the one deliberate difference from the ledger exemption surfaces, where an unmatched entry is a stale debt. An ABSENT file means this factory has declared no live paths, which is the shipped state of a new factory; a file that exists and cannot be read is a reported problem, because only the silent failure is the hazard.
